text: {"lessons":["My account has risen steadily so far, but a few good months do not guarantee future gains; I should protect the savings I rely on for living expenses.","Selling 20 shares of Stock E at a substantial gain realized some profit, but I should make decisions based on my overall plan rather than the gain alone.","I have traded infrequently and that suits my experience; I should avoid unnecessary trading and keep an eye on account swings and my need for stability."]}
